title: Kotak PCG research one-pager
description: Contract between the PDF-extraction bot and Strapi. Covers PAGE 1 of the one-pager only -- pages 2-4 are static boilerplate held in src/boilerplate.js and are never parsed.

reportId.description: Jamun report id, taken from the PDF filename prefix (e.g. '131440_1').

sourcePdf.description: Public S3 URL of the source PDF. Rendered as the 'Download full report' button.

publishedAt.description: Report date from the PDF header ('Dated: 21 May 2026' -> '2026-05-21'). NOT the publish date on the website.

slug.description: URL slug of the recommendation page, for cross-linking.

template.description: e.g. 'One Pager'. Selects the renderer once more templates exist.

rating.description: Must match the PCG rating scale on page 2 of the PDF.

cmp.description: Current Market Price as printed in the report. Always displayed with an 'as on <date>' qualifier so it cannot be mistaken for the live ticker price.

fairValue.description: Null for NR / RS reports. When null, the Fair Value and Upside tiles are omitted.

sections.description: Ordered content sections. Generic on purpose: future report types add sections without a schema change.

id.description: Slug used for the aria-labelledby anchor.

tone.description: Drives the icon and marker colour only. Never introduces a non-brand colour.

abbreviations.description: The glossary line at the foot of page 1.

attribution.description: The KIE-derivation note at the foot of page 1.
